A simple timeline of the Abacha regime from 1993 to 1998. Key points on the line: Nov 1993 (Abacha takes power), May 1994 (NADECO formed), June 1994 (Abiola arrested), 1994-1995 (Constitutional Conference), Nov 1995 (Execution of Ogoni nine and Commonwealth suspension), Oct 1996 (Creation of 6 new states), 1997 (coup in Sierra Leone) and 1998 (ECOMOG ousts the junta; President Kabbah returns), June 1998 (Death of Abacha). Clean flat textbook illustration, white background.
